versions.description:
This Takaro module acts as an automated 48-hour player activity tracking and chart-generation system for 7 Days to Die servers, posting a rolling visual graph directly to a Discord channel.

Use this module to:
- Query online players through the game server command interface.
- Track hourly peak player counts over a rolling 48-hour window.
- Post a clean text-based Discord chart using emoji blocks.
- Store history and the Discord message ID in Takaro variables so the same message is updated over time.

Good fit for 7 Days to Die servers that want a lightweight public activity graph without external dashboards.

Old name: Wykres Aktywnosci.

## Screenshot

![SVM Activity Tracker 48-hour server activity chart](/images/svmotnik/wykres-aktywnosci-48h.webp)
